To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the structure and connectivity of nucleus HVc in adult zebrafinches are complex, that there are three subdivisions of HVc in male zebra finches, and that HVc in adult females is very different from that in males.

1) HVc in adult male zebra finches has three subdivisions with distinct cytoarchitecture and projections, 2) these subdivisions are similar to subdivisions in adult male canaries, and 3) HVc in females is very small and lacks the subdivisions seen in males, but can be masculinized by estradiol treatment at 15 days.
